_comment: Telegram Media Downloader Pro reads this file. Edit it, run  python deploy_content.py  then push ghpages/ to github.com/lyrasoftt/tmdp . Every installed copy picks up the change on its next start - no new build needed. Image paths starting with / are resolved against whichever address served this file.
_moved_to: To move every installed copy to a new address, add  "moved_to": "https://new-address"  while this address still answers, then sign and push. The app follows it once and remembers it.

products.name: Telegram Media Downloader Pro
products.tagline: Bulk-download photos, video, audio and files from any Telegram chat
products.description: Point it at a channel, group or private chat and it saves every matching file at once - pick the media types and formats you want, watch live speed and progress, keep original filenames. Works with public links, invite links and numeric IDs.
